name: PA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Dean holds a large cash advantage ($1.2M vs $4K) in a D+8 district
Incumbent Dean running with strong fundraising ($1.37M raised)
Challenger Stuski has minimal resources and no outside support
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Dean: a D+8 district, incumbency, and a massive financial edge over a barely funded challenger, with markets pricing her near-certain. No polls or ratings contradict this picture, so the forecast stays at a Safe D margin near the district's structural lean.
model.watch: A late red-wave national environment or unexpected outside spending against Dean could narrow the margin, though not likely enough to threaten the seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Madeleine Dean seeks another term in this Democratic-leaning Montgomery County district. She has raised over $1.3 million and holds about $1.2 million on hand, while Republican Aurora Stuski has raised under $9,000 with no outside support. Prediction markets give Dean roughly a 96% chance of winning, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive.

With no public polling available, the forecast rests on the district's partisan lean, Dean's incumbency advantage, and the lopsided financial picture. All of these point the same direction: a comfortable Democratic win, with the main uncertainty being the size of the margin rather than the outcome.
